page.title: Bambu Usage Tracking
page.subtitle: Deducts the filament used by Bambu Lab prints from the matching FilaMan spools and keeps a print history with plate previews.
page.footer: FilaManBambuUsage, MIT. Consumption logic ported from OpenSpoolMan (MIT).

notice.heading: Nothing to see yet
notice.lead: This plugin is milestone 1: specification and scaffold.
notice.body: It builds, installs and mounts, but tracks nothing. It connects to no printer and changes no spool. The point of this stage is to prove that the plugin approach holds before any logic is written.

roadmap.heading: What comes next
roadmap.stage2: a listener per printer, reading the 3MF, deducting network prints, history with previews, correcting an assignment after the fact
roadmap.stage3: local prints, through filament change detection
roadmap.stage4: per layer tracking, proportional deduction on abort

requirements.heading: Requirements
requirements.printersValue: at least one using the {driver} driver
requirements.credentialsValue: taken from the printer, nothing to enter twice
requirements.networkValue: MQTT and FTPS on the LAN, no Bambu cloud
